from_env(): CLI → env → defaults
app_id · private_key · webhook_secret
max_distance=0.15 · top_k=3 · pool_size=20
max_files_per_pr=50 · max_elements_per_pr=200
allowed_orgs · check_public · check_private
comment_on_zero_hits

actions: opened · synchronize · reopened

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Authentication
_generate_jwt() — RS256, iss=app_id, exp=9min
_get_token(owner) — GET /app/installations → find id
POST /installations/{id}/access_tokens
→ _token_cache[owner] with 5-min refresh buffer

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Data Fetching
get_pr_files() — GET /pulls/{n}/files, paginated 100/page
→ List[PRFile: filename · status · patch · additions · deletions]
get_file_content() — GET /contents/{path}?ref=sha
base64 decode or download_url fallback → Optional[bytes]
cap: cfg.max_files_per_pr (50)

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Comment Management
find_bot_comment() — scan for COMMENT_SIGNATURE marker
upsert_pr_comment() — POST (new) or PATCH (update)
delete_comment() — DELETE, silent on 404

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 1 — Filter source files
core/source_filtering.py — is_noise_source_path()
EXCLUDED_DIR_NAMES · EXCLUDED_EXTENSIONS · EXCLUDED_EXACT_FILENAMES
core/language_detection.py — has_language_hint() · is_probably_binary()
identify lib + SUFFIX_TO_TREE_SITTER + HINT_TO_TREE_SITTER maps
Size guard — CODE_SIM_MAX_FILE_BYTES (250KB)

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 2 — Parse code & diff-filter changed elements
core/code_parser.py — extract_code_elements()
Tree-sitter AST → function/method/constructor declarations
→ CodeElement: id · name · kind · start_line · end_line · text · hash
_file_level_elements() fallback for unparseable files
core/runtime.py — parse_staged_new_ranges(patch)
Parse @@ hunk headers from PRFile.patch
_element_overlaps_any_changed_range()
Only analyse elements touching changed lines

infra/embeddings.py — load_embedding_config(db_path, type)
Match index-time settings for consistent query vectors
EmbeddingClient.embed_documents(texts, labels)
batch_size · max_chars · long_text chunking/truncation
→ HTTP POST /v1/embeddings → vLLM Server

.query_public_by_embedding(vector, n_results=pool_size)

→ ChromaDB hnsw:cosine search
checking/check_utils.py — extract_hits()
_make_private_hit_filter() · max_distance · top_k selection
